example.title: Irondequoit Bay Bridge (NY 104 over Irondequoit Bay)

brief: Lakeshore Rd over the Kettle River's broad basin by Lake Tamsin. Modelled on the Irondequoit Bay Bridge, opened February 1970: a low continuous steel deck truss (724 m, 14 m clearance) crossing the bay on concrete piers founded on clustered piles (268 piles in 20 capped clusters). Here: continuous deck-truss spans across the channel, on the same pile-cluster piers across the basin. The lowest of the Kettle bridges; weathered green-grey steel. Foundations: capped pile clusters 25 m below the modelled bed.
